value.signature: fn content_matches_supplied_commitment (id : & ActId , p : & ProposalCommitment , recorded : & ContentCommitment , salt : & SecretSlice < u8 > , payload : & SecretSlice < u8 > ,) -> Result < () , ProfileError >

review.body: { if recorded . recipe != CONTENT_RECIPE { return Err (ProfileError :: Recipe) ; } if content_commitment (id , p , salt , payload) ? != * recorded { return Err (ProfileError :: Mismatch) ; } Ok (()) }
